solution.approach: Use nested loops to iterate through rows and columns, printing characters corresponding to the pattern formula.

code.C:
#include <stdio.h>
int main() { int n; if(scanf("%d",&n)==1){for(int i=n;i>=1;i--){for(int j=0;j<i;j++)putchar('A'+n-1-j);putchar('\n');}}return 0; }
code.Java:
import java.util.Scanner;
public class Main{public static void main(String[] args){Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);if(sc.hasNextInt()){int n=sc.nextInt();for(int i=n;i>=1;i--){StringBuilder sb=new StringBuilder();for(int j=0;j<i;j++)sb.append((char)('A'+n-1-j));System.out.println(sb);}}}}

solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Print the required pattern line-by-line using nested loops based on line index and character offset.

hints: Determine the number of rows from N.
Identify the formula relating row index to characters printed per line.
Output each row on a new line.
learningObjectives: Master nested loops for 2D character grids.
